sn45.139:1.2: Yāvatā bhikkhave sattā apadā vā dvipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā nevasaññināsaññino vā || Tathāgato tesam aggam akkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ||
sn45.139:1.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā ||
sn45.139:1.5: Appamattassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno paṭikaṅkhaṃ ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati a- a- maggam bahulīkarissati || ||
sn45.139:1.6: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu appamatto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn45.139:1.7: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitam vossaggaparināmim || la-pe || sammāsamādhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || 5.
sn45.139:1.8: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu appamatto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkarotīti || ||
sn45.139:2.5: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti rāgavinaya- dosavinaya- mohavinayapariyosānaṃ || || 4.
sn45.139:3.5: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti amatogadham amataparāyanam amatapariyosānaṃ || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti amatogadham amataparāyanam amatapariyosānaṃ || || 4.
sn45.139:4.6: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇam nibbānapabbhāraṃ || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇam nibbānapabbhāraṃ || || 1.
